recipe: SOURCES.md 1F (decided by the coordinator for A1, Oct 11): base = unweighted average of the eight Western adult samples in Garcia et al. 2022 Supporting Information Table A3 (centre = mean of the sexes' means, s = mean of the sexes' SDs); sex split = UK d from Lee & Ashton 2020 Table 2 (p.1082; age-corrected; HEXACO-100), women centre + d*s/2, men centre - d*s/2; domains multivariate normal with Garcia SI Table A10 averaged intercorrelations, SD = s within sex, clipped 1-5; Honesty-Humility age term (.145/17.32)*s*(age - 41.6) (Garcia Table 4 p.267 median r; SD age p.259; base mean age 41.6 from Table A1)
